captions.detailed: A naval deck cannon mounted on a brown, planked wooden deck segment. The assembly features a dark gray circular deck ring and a matching dark gray pivot carriage with dual vertical support brackets. Resting on this carriage is a bronze-colored cylindrical cannon barrel with a tapered body, flared muzzle, and a rear cascabel. The carriage can rotate horizontally on a continuous revolute ring joint, while the barrel elevates vertically on a revolute trunnion joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of a naval deck cannon. The model should include a planked wooden deck base, a dark gray circular traversing deck ring, a pivot carriage with vertical side plates, and a bronze-colored cannon barrel. Implement two revolute joints: one for the horizontal rotation of the carriage on the deck ring, and one for the vertical elevation of the barrel.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model in several parts using CadQuery primitives. First, the deck is created as a flat box with linear grooves to simulate wooden planks. Next, the deck ring is modeled as a flat cylinder. The pivot carriage is built from a base plate and two vertical support plates using box primitives. The barrel is constructed by lofting or unioning multiple cylinders of varying radii to create the tapered cannon shape with a hollow muzzle. Finally, the parts are assembled with a revolute joint between the deck and carriage for horizontal rotation, and another revolute joint between the carriage and barrel for vertical elevation.
